title: CI/CD and release management for the Connect platform
scenario: Larkspur ships Connect changes by console clicks, a JSON export script and a Tuesday-night CAB spreadsheet of ARNs; DR is three releases behind and broken flows are found by agents. Design the CI/CD and release management for Sandbox, Dev, Test, Prod and DR within GitHub Actions, OIDC, CAB and offshore-team constraints.
task: Decide what is managed as code and with which tool, precisely per resource type
Design promotion with generated manifests and fail-closed reference rewriting
Sketch the GitHub Actions pipeline with gates, tests and approvals
Define release and rollback for Lambdas, Lex, modules and flows, plus monitoring and governance
acceptance: Graded by rubric (no automated tests; grade.sh reports 0/0)
Correct about CFN/CDK/Terraform coverage, flow versions vs module aliases and native flow test cases
Concrete pipeline, testing, rollback, alarms and offshore RACI
